reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: Got this as a replacement for my original Asus MB that i damaged some CPU socket pins on. It’s hard to find a board with DDR4 and WiFi 6 anymore. Especially at a decent price. This worked perfectly and after a small hiccup (missed moving the SSD over) it booted up perfectly with no issues

reviews.title: Great deal
reviews.comment: This has almost everything you’ll need for a decent PC build. USB 3.2 is a great plus along with Q Flash and inbuilt WiFi. The BIOS is good too. I messed up the build initially with some loose cable. But, the beep codes are really helpful. I googled and found the issue. Right now, I don’t think there is a better motherboard at this price. Cons: the IO shield took me a while to install. It is possible that I wasn’t doing it right though as it was my first time assembling a PC I would’ve liked some head sinks on top of the VRMs, but it gets the job done.
